name: @vzn/vx-cache-server
description: A cache and run-history server for vx that you host: on Bun with an S3-compatible bucket, or on Cloudflare Workers with D1 and R2.
//: @vzn/vx: vx.config.ts's core; `*`, not workspace:, which npm refuses when a deploy installs this directory alone.
@vzn/vx-devtools: checks the CI tokens, the check vx's servers share (it imports only jose); `*` for the same reason.
jose: the tests sign the CI tokens the server checks.
miniflare: tests/worker.test.ts runs src/worker.ts in workerd with D1 and R2, as Workers deploy it.
